subject: Air-gapped POC credit request and compliance clearance
messages:
From: Jules Carter <jules@medsecure.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC - air-gapped environment & pilot credits

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at MedSecure is excited about Redwood's ability to run in a private VPC / air-gapped mode. Our security team requires an air-gapped POC for any model that touches PHI. Before we spin up an internal evaluation, we need to understand if Redwood can sponsor pilot credits for an isolated 1-2 node air-gapped trial and provide (or point to) the compliance artifacts we need for procurement (SOC 2 summary, network diagram, DPA).

Key asks:
- Confirmation of sponsored credits and length (we typically run 60-120 day POCs)
- Evidence: SOC 2 summary, network diagram showing the air-gapped packaging, and confirmation of any key management options (KMS/HSM) for the pilot
- A mutual action plan (deliverables / acceptance criteria) so procurement can move fast

Can you loop in whoever owns compliance approvals and confirm what we can expect next week? We are aiming to start the POC by Aug 23 if everything is green.

Best,
Jules
Director, Cloud Engineering
MedSecure Inc.
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Jules Carter <jules@medsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC - air-gapped environment & pilot credits

Hi Jules — thanks for the clear list. I can confirm Redwood supports an air-gapped Private deployment for POCs and we can provide a pilot credit sponsorship to cover cloud / infra costs while you evaluate. High-level:

- Proposed sponsorship: $15,000 in platform credits, valid for 120 days, dedicated 1-2 GPU nodes in a shielded VPC (we can scale to 2 nodes as needed).
- Evidence included: SOC 2 summary attached; we will follow up with a network diagram specific to the air-gapped package (Neha, can you attach the diagram and DPA?).
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed KMS and can enable an HSM-backed key in Private deployments (details below).

Next steps:
1) Neha (Security) to confirm evidence and any additional controls.
2) Marissa (Account) to prepare the trial MOU and credit paperwork.
3) Jules to confirm acceptance of the $15k / 120-day terms and target start date (Aug 23).

If that looks OK I will mark this as approved for the next stage and share the mutual action plan doc.

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jules Carter <jules@medsecure.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC - air-gapped environment & pilot credits

Connor,

Appreciate the quick response. $15k / 120 days sounds reasonable. Two follow-ups from my side:
- Procurement typically requires the network diagram for our security review before we sign MOU. Can you provide the diagram showing where the air-gapped nodes will sit and what (if any) egress is allowed?
- Can you confirm whether any logs or telemetry will leave the air-gapped environment during the trial? Our compliance team is strict about telemetry egress.

If you can get the diagram and telemetry confirmation to me by Wednesday, I can push procurement to sign the MOU this week.

Thanks,
Jules
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC - air-gapped environment & pilot credits

On Mon, Aug 10, 2026 at 09:08 Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - Evidence included: SOC 2 summary attached; we will follow up with a network diagram specific to the air-gapped package (Neha, can you attach the diagram and DPA?).

Connor / Marissa — attaching the network diagram draft (network_diagram_airgapped.png) and a short note on telemetry. Highlights:
- Telemetry: by default, no runtime telemetry leaves the isolated deployment. We only surface admin-level health checks to the customer's management plane when explicitly consented. For this trial we will disable external telemetry and provide logs in-scope via secure bundle transfer.
- KMS/HSM: we can enable customer-managed KMS; HSM-backed keys are available as an opt-in.
- DPA: Legal has prepared a one-off DPA for trial use; I asked Legal to provide the signed copy (DPA_signed.pdf).

Marissa, please prepare the trial MOU with the $15k / 120 days, and mark it under "Security-gated pilot" template so procurement sees the controls up front.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: network_diagram_airgapped.png
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jules Carter <jules@medsecure.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC - air-gapped environment & pilot credits

Jules — thanks for confirming. This email confirms approval of a $15,000 credit sponsorship for a 120-day air-gapped Private POC starting Aug 23, 2026. What we are delivering:

- Sponsored credits: $15,000 applied to the MedSecure account, valid for 120 days from first environment activation.
- Dedicated environment: 1-2 GPU nodes in a shielded VPC, air-gapped configuration, no external telemetry (per Neha).
- Compliance artifacts: SOC2_summary.pdf (attached), network_diagram_airgapped.png (attached), DPA_signed.pdf (attached).

Next actions for onboarding (mutual action plan):
1) Jules: confirm Aug 23 activation and provide contact for your infra team (IP admin + SRE).
2) Marissa: share MOU and credit application (DocuSign link) by end of day.
3) Neha: schedule a short security walk-through with MedSecure's secops to go over telemetry and key handling.

If you want the HSM-backed key enabled for the POC please indicate that in your reply — it requires a brief key provisioning step.

Looking forward to getting this moving.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf; DPA_signed.pdf; network_diagram_airgapped.png
